prompt:
Wildcard routes over-match with PatternRouter and LinearRouter

When I use `PatternRouter` (e.g. via `hono/tiny`) or `LinearRouter` (e.g. `new Hono({ router: new LinearRouter() })`), routes that end with a wildcard match paths they should not match. The default `RegExpRouter` and `TrieRouter` behave correctly, so the same app gives different results depending on the router.

Reproduction:

```ts
import { Hono } from 'hono'
import { PatternRouter } from 'hono/router/pattern-router'

const app = new Hono({ router: new PatternRouter() })
app.get('/assets*', (c) => c.text('assets'))
app.get('/path/*', (c) => c.text('path'))
app.get('/a/*/b/*', (c) => c.text('b'))

for (const p of ['/asset', '/pathfoo', '/a/x/bz']) {
  console.log(p, (await app.request(p)).status)
}
```

Actual: all three requests return 200 (they hit the `assets`, `path` and `b` handlers). The same happens with `LinearRouter`.

Expected: all three return 404, while these must keep matching:
- `/assets*` matches `/assets`, `/assets-v2` and `/assets/app.js` (a bare `*` suffix is a plain prefix match on the full literal `/assets`), but not `/asset`.
- `/path/*` matches `/path` and `/path/to/file`, but not `/pathfoo` (a trailing `/*` only matches at a segment boundary).
- `/a/*/b/*` matches `/a/x/b` and `/a/x/b/c`, but not `/a/x/bz`.

Both routers should agree with `RegExpRouter` and `TrieRouter` on these cases, and existing routing behavior should otherwise be unchanged.
